user.title: Prad - meters
user.description: Select the energy meters. Either two cumulative meters (import and export) or one net meter that rises on import and falls on export. PV and temperature are optional.

taryfa.title: Tariff and net-metering ratio
taryfa.description: Choose the tariff and the net-metering ratio. You will fill in the prices later in Configure → Price lists.

strefy.title: Own off-peak hours
strefy.description: Full hours 0-23. A range may cross midnight (22 → 6). G12 hours differ between operators and years - enter them from your contract or tariff.

error.grid_required_dwa: Select both the import and the export energy meters.
error.net_state_class: The net meter must have state_class: total (total_increasing treats a decrease as a reset).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Prad entry is allowed.

create_entry.default: Fill in the prices in Configure → Price lists.

liczniki.title: Meters
liczniki.description: Changing a meter does not erase history, storage or invoices. The hour of the change is not counted.

cenniki.title: Price lists

menu_options.cennik_add: Add a price list from a date

cennik_dane.title: Price list - date and tariff
cennik_dane.description: The price changes at midnight of the given day. The tariff or zone hours can only change from the first day of a month.

cennik_ceny.title: Price list - net prices
cennik_ceny.description: Net prices from the invoice or tariff: per kWh (energy, distribution, fees) and per month (fixed fees).

magazyn_korekta.name: Storage correction
magazyn_korekta.description: Adds (positive) or removes (negative) kWh in the energy storage.

ilosc.name: Amount
ilosc.description: Amount in kWh; negative reduces the storage.

wpisz_fakture.name: Enter invoice
wpisz_fakture.description: Stores the invoice amount for a closed month and appends it to the CSV file.

inicjuj.name: Rebuild from history
inicjuj.description: Rebuilds months and storage from the given date using hourly recorder statistics.

od.name: From day
od.description: First day of the rebuild (local time).

poczatek_magazynu.name: Storage start
poczatek_magazynu.description: First month settled with storage, YYYY-MM.

potwierdz.name: Confirm
potwierdz.description: Required when history already exists; the state is overwritten (a backup is kept).
